```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

ROOT = Path.cwd()
while not (ROOT / "_quarto.yml").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import chart_style as cs
import regulation_view as rv

ev, inst, log = rv.load()
ms = rv.load_milestones()
```

```{python}
#| label: intro
Markdown(f"""
{len(ms)} changes that mattered for how prices form, who can operate and what kinds of business are allowed, from the first market law in 2001 to 2026.
Each card says what changed in a few sentences and names the legal instruments behind it, with what each rests on and a link to the page it was read on.
The colour is the type of reform. Cards marked **draft** rest on the EPİAŞ handbook, a news report or inference; the others were read on a page that
reproduces the official text. Where a sentence comes from the handbook or the press, the card says so.

The [instrument index](instruments.qmd) lists every instrument in one compact table, [institutions](institutions.qmd) says who does what, and
[method](method.qmd) explains how this was researched and what was not read.
""")
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## Not legal advice, and not complete
This is a reading aid built from public pages. It covers milestones, not every amendment, and dates are those shown on the pages read.
Check the official text (Resmî Gazete, mevzuat.gov.tr, EPDK) before relying on an entry.
:::

```{python}
#| label: timeline
HTML(rv.vertical_timeline(ms, ev))
```

## Download

```{python}
#| label: download
out = ev.drop(columns=["when"])
HTML(cs.download_link(ms, "tr_power_lab_market_milestones.csv", "Milestones (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(out, "tr_power_lab_regulation_instruments.csv", "Instruments (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(inst, "tr_power_lab_institutions.csv", "Institutions (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(log, "tr_power_lab_regulation_research_log.csv", "Research log (CSV)"))
```

In the instruments file, `parent` links each instrument to the one it rests on. `status` is `verified` or `draft`.
